foundations.statement: Existence and finite-positive-scalar uniqueness of Haar measure on locally compact groups, Haar products and pushforwards under topological group isomorphisms, Tonelli integration, and the local analytic derivative formula for the modulus of an automorphism. The weak source predicate, relevant unimodularity/action moduli, exact subgroups, product normalizations and covolume are proved explicitly in AMD4–17.

Finite-dimensional tensor algebra, finite projective number-field lattices and their completions, polynomial matrix exponential/logarithm in characteristic zero, nilpotent Lie-algebra central flags, and the additive Chinese remainder theorem. The actual adelic splitting, coordinate topology, group structure and compact representative induction are given in the numbered proofs.

Exactly the original AutInst/CM/Hermitian/standard-frame data and the given Haar or IsHaarOnSet measures where the source quantifies them. AMD12 takes the original antecedent blocks of MExists; it does not require independently producing their Bessel block.

Only the final rescaling interpretation retains the original compatible orbital measures, normalized local fiber measures and Siegel–Weil premise. These are not hypotheses added to MGExists, MWCore, InfTransfer, MExists, prescribed extension or unipotent covolume one.
